name: event-loop-blocking
title: fix(runtime): 事件循环阻塞——provider 首次导入与同步 DNS 导致 /status 12-58s（票 5cu）
description: 追查生产路径 /status 偶发 12-58s：latency 采样显示时间全在 aget_state，但直连 SQL 0-16ms、blob 仅 KB；给 saver 打点发现 aput 自身 11-22s、读者只是在等同一把 saver 锁；心跳看门狗抓到 3.3s 事件循环卡顿与 traceback——根因是 async 节点里的同步阻塞：Windows 上 socket.gethostbyname('host.containers.internal') 走满 DNS 超时（约12s，trend_scout→granted_scopes→load_credential→get_account_cdp_endpoint），以及首次 model 创建在循环内 import langchain_anthropic（数秒）。修复：启动时用 asyncio.to_thread 预加载 provider SDK（API lifespan + CLI run）；CDP host 解析改用 to_thread 并 lru_cache；publisher 容器探测抽成缓存函数并提供 async 包装，发布/free 路径改用异步版本。实测 /status 12-58s→1.08s、LOOP STALLED 3次→0、单次 aput ≤1.06s。补三组 off-loop 回归测试；文档同步。
creator: codex
notes: DONE 2026-11-04. Chased the last open observation from the functional-test round (production path /status 12-58s right after start) to its real cause: synchronous work running on the event loop, not Postgres. Evidence chain: XHS_LATENCY_LOG showed total 34.3s with aget_state 34.3s but db 7ms; a direct psycopg read of the same thread's checkpoint took 0-16ms and checkpoint rows/blobs are only KB; instrumenting AsyncPostgresSaver showed aput itself taking 11-22s with readers merely waiting on that saver's single asyncio.Lock; a heartbeat watchdog (independent thread checking loop progress every 0.5s) caught LOOP STALLED 3.3s with tracebacks pointing at socket.gethostbyname('host.containers.internal') inside trend_scout -> granted_scopes -> load_credential -> get_account_cdp_endpoint (Windows spends the full DNS timeout ~12s on a non-existent container host) and at the first _create_model lazy import of langchain_anthropic inside an async node. Fixes: preload_model_providers() imports langchain_openai/langchain_anthropic at startup via asyncio.to_thread in the API lifespan and in CLI run; _resolve_cdp_host is lru_cached and called through asyncio.to_thread from get_account_cdp_endpoint; publisher's container CDP probe is cached and exposed as _resolve_cdp_endpoint_async used by the publisher path and the free-mode route. Measured on embedded Postgres with real magpie workflows: /status 12.4/12.4/23.8/35.2s (once 58s) before vs 1.08/1.08/1.09/3.5s after; watchdog stalls 2-3 per run (3-11s each) before vs 0 after; slowest aput 22s before vs 1.06s after. Tests added: blocking sleep in a thread must not stop an event-loop ticker (accounts + publisher async wrapper) and the preload imports both SDKs idempotently. Focused suites 203 passed; full suite under XHS_PG_PARITY_URI and CI verified separately. deployment.md documents the corrected explanation and numbers.
